If you missed the beginning — [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3776810/announcements/detail/532104920883537601"]check the link[/url] and catch up 🗂️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665475/2205c9549cf90a6990e2a18f0d923ea0c4068f9a.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 [b]Suspicion falls on the neighbor[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Farmer Bob immediately pointed to his neighbor:[/h3][p]
— [i]“It’s Martin Stevens! He’s been eyeing my tractor for ages. Even his wife admitted that the tractor has ‘more personality’ than me.”[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Stevens was brought in for questioning.[/h3][p][/p][h3]At first glance — just an ordinary guy: mustache, flannel shirt, calm look.[/h3][p][/p][p]He didn’t flinch:
— [i]“I was home. Frying bacon. Got the store receipt to prove it. And my hands are clean — what would I need a stolen tractor for?”[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]But strange things were found in his shed:[/h3][p]
🥾 a pair of muddy boots — size 44 (Stevens wears 41),
🗺️ a map of a forest trail marked “exit to highway,”
🧴 and a can of anti-puncture tire foam.[/p][p][/p][h3]Martin claims it’s all “old junk from the garage.”[/h3][p][/p][h2]But the clues speak louder:[/h2][p]
— the tire tracks lead into the woods,
— the fence was broken exactly where that trail begins.[/p][p][/p][h3]Is he just a thrifty neighbor?[/h3][h2]
Or a mastermind of rural theft?[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Not Guilty — what do you say, detective? The investigation continues.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Cucumbers, Tracks, and a Missing Tractor
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Hey there, judges!
🕵️‍♂️ What’s up, detectives![/h2][p]
🧑‍🌾 In the morning, Farmer Bob went out to the field…
… and didn’t find his tractor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665475/dc92a0265f8cd928fc51ce4883913f672c13b69b.png"][/img][/p][p]
On the ground — only strange round tracks, a smashed jar of pickles,
and a scrap of denim stuck in the fence.[/p][p][/p][h2]Neighbors claim:[/h2][p]
— the tractor drove by itself,
— country music was playing from the speakers,
— and the wheel was turned… by a cat in a baseball cap.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Clues:[/b][/h2][p]
🚜 Tire tracks leading into the forest
🥒 A jar of pickles with fingerprints
🧢 A torn piece of a cap with the words “MEOW POWER”[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Suspects:[/b][/h2][p]
— A local blogger who recently filmed a video about “smart farms”
— Bob’s brother, fired from a factory for his obsession with mechanics
— Tim the Cat, the calmest in the area… until yesterday[/p][p][/p][h3]Was it a theft, a performance, or the beginning of a machine uprising?[/h3][h3][/h3][h3][b]The case is open.[/b][/h3][h3]
[b]Not Guilty — the truth is up to you.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Case “The White Trail” Solved!
notes.content:
[h2]🌟 Hello, Judges!
🕵️‍♀️ Greetings, Detectives![/h2][p]
This is the end. The clues form a clear picture. The witnesses have spoken. It's time to pass judgment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665475/9be32a30f29ffc38715851060866cbbbdc5bb759.png"][/img][/p][h3]🖌️ [b]Clue: Empty mayonnaise bucket[/b][/h3][p]
Forensic analysis revealed greasy fingerprints on the handle… and an imprint of a distinctive ring. Only one person in the city wears such a ring.[/p][p][/p][h3]👂 [b]Testimony: Martin Larson, janitor[/b][/h3][p]
“I saw Julia near the park that night. She was carrying something in a bucket and muttering to herself: ‘If Samuel can’t finish it — I’ll do it myself.’ She looked really mad.”[/p][p][/p][h3]⚖️ [b]Verdict: GUILTY![/b][/h3][p]
🎨 Julia Hunt is guilty. She wanted to finish what Samuel started to draw attention to his exhibition. The ring’s print and the janitor’s testimony sealed her fate. Samuel, in fact, spent the whole night working at the gallery.[/p][p][/p][h3]✅ [b]Case Closed![/b][/h3][h3]
Congrats to the detectives who figured out Julia's role. Your sharp thinking deserves praise![/h3][h3]
🔥 But don’t relax — more cases and twisted mysteries lie ahead.[/h3]
